scope: Actual positive resource deltas and spending only on main-paced steps in confirmed main-action transactions. All main actions reconciled. This includes card, planet, alien, and triggered effects occurring inside the transaction; excludes separate quick steps including data placement and trades. It is not a causal marginal value or complete action-chain net return. Legacy human snapshots/version differ and may omit transactions. Data per action is ratio of totals, not average of per-seat ratios. No new games or counterfactuals.
